up: Retrieve records for compounds tested against the human protein target 'Amine oxidase [flavin-containing] A' (also known as MAO-A or MAO-B depending on context, but specifically matching the target name). For each activity, return: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, pubmed_id_or_doi (preferring pubmed_id, falling back to doi), assay_description, target_chembl_id, target_pref_name, and exact standard_value in nM. Include only rows where standard_type is 'IC50', standard_units is 'nM', and standard_relation is '='. Ensure that each returned row has a non-null canonical_smiles and a non-null pubmed_id_or_doi. Join activities with assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, compound_structures, and docs. Filter assays by target name 'Amine oxidase [flavin-containing] A' and organism 'Homo sapiens'. Do not apply any confidence score filters. Return all matching rows without a row limit.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, CASE WHEN d.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL THEN d.pubmed_id ELSE d.doi END AS pubmed_id_or_doi, ass.description AS assay_description, td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id, td.pref_name AS target_pref_name, a.standard_value FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE td.pref_name = 'Amine oxidase [flavin-containing] A' AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_units = 'nM' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL AND (d.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR d.doi IS NOT NULL)
